user.title: Connect to Kept
user.description: Make a personal token in Kept under Settings → Connections. Read only is enough for the sensors and the calendar; Read and change also lets the actions send readings and mark schedules done.

data_description.url: The address you open Kept at, e.g. {example}
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a self-signed certificate on your own network.

confirm.title: Kept {version} at {host}
confirm.description: The token reaches {count} location(s): {locations}. Each becomes a device with its counts and a calendar; each vehicle gets its reading and next service.

reauth_confirm.title: New token for {host}
reauth_confirm.description: The token was revoked or has expired. Make a new one in Kept under Settings → Connections.

error.invalid_url: Enter the full address, starting with https:// or http://.
error.invalid_token_format: A Kept personal token starts with kpt_.
error.cannot_connect: Kept can't be reached at that address.
error.not_kept: Something answered at that address, but it isn't Kept.
error.invalid_auth: Kept refused the token: it was revoked, has expired or was mistyped.
error.kept_too_old: This Kept doesn't offer the summary to tokens yet. Update Kept.
error.use_https: That address redirects to HTTPS. Use {location}
error.redirected: That address redirects to {location}. Enter the address Kept is served at.
error.ssl_certificate: The HTTPS certificate isn't trusted. Use a trusted certificate, or turn off the certificate check for a self-signed one.
error.ssl_error: HTTPS failed at that address. If Kept is served over plain HTTP there, use http://.

abort.already_configured: This Kept is already set up.

data_description.locations: The token's locations to show. All of them, when every one is ticked.

no_entry.message: No Kept is set up, or not the one named.

several_entries.message: More than one Kept is set up: name the one to use.

no_meter.message: That device isn't a Kept vehicle with a meter.

schedule_not_found.message: Kept has no schedule with that id that this token can see.

log_reading.name: Log a reading
log_reading.description: Sends a meter reading to Kept, such as a car's odometer.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The Kept vehicle whose meter it is.

meter_id.name: Meter ID
meter_id.description: Instead of the vehicle: the meter's ID, shown on its Reading sensor.

value.name: Value
value.description: The reading, in the meter's unit. At most 3 decimals are kept.

taken_at.name: Taken at
taken_at.description: When it was read. Now, if left out.

config_entry_id.name: Kept
config_entry_id.description: Which Kept, when more than one is set up.

complete_schedule.name: Mark a schedule done
complete_schedule.description: Marks a Kept schedule done and records the service.

done_on.name: Done on
done_on.description: The day it was done. Today, if left out.

value.name: Meter reading
value.description: For a schedule by meter: the reading when it was done.

config_entry_id.name: Kept
config_entry_id.description: Which Kept, when more than one is set up.
